id./param/scenario/cs/b_060_cs_040.pack|cs_: "...Now, since you came here, you've lost your way. Allow me a moment.
"Hm... You think you've lost the Luminary's power, don't you?
"...Sadly, there is nothing I can do. But I can say one thing.
"You think Mordegon crushed the Luminary's power...
"Power can't be seen or touched. It isn't something so frail it can be easily crushed.
"What, you still don't understand? Well, that's fine for now.
"As fish bite when it's time, you'll grasp it of yourself when the time comes.
"...By the way, you're drowning right now, aren't you?
"Don't worry. The Tree says you are not fated to fall yet.
"Now, you can't sleep forever. You are the Luminary. You know what you must do, don't you?
